hero.headline: Wood-fired pizza, made with care.
hero.subtitle: Simple ingredients, honest recipes, and a 900°F oven. Bianco has been baking Neapolitan-style pies in the neighborhood since 2014.

items.name: Burrata al Forno
items.description: Oven-warmed burrata, cherry tomato confit, basil oil, and grilled sourdough.

items.name: Garlic Knots
items.description: Hand-tied dough knots brushed with garlic butter and parmesan, served with marinara.

items.name: Caprese Salad
items.description: Heirloom tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, basil, and a balsamic reduction.

items.name: Antipasto Board
items.description: Cured meats, aged cheeses, marinated olives, roasted peppers, and crostini.

items.name: Margherita
items.description: San Marzano tomato, fresh mozzarella, basil, extra virgin olive oil.

items.name: Pepperoni
items.description: Double pepperoni, low-moisture mozzarella, San Marzano tomato, oregano.

items.name: Quattro Formaggi
items.description: Mozzarella, gorgonzola, fontina, and parmesan with a whisper of honey.

items.name: Funghi e Tartufo
items.description: Wild mushrooms, mozzarella, taleggio, and black truffle oil.

items.name: Diavola
items.description: Spicy soppressata, calabrian chili, mozzarella, and San Marzano tomato.

items.name: Vegetale

items.name: Tiramisu
items.description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers, mascarpone cream, and cocoa.

items.name: Cannoli
items.description: Crisp shells filled with sweet ricotta and chocolate chips.

items.name: Affogato
items.description: Vanilla gelato drowned in a shot of hot espresso.

items.name: Nutella Calzone
items.description: Folded wood-fired dough with warm Nutella and powdered sugar.

items.name: Italian Soda
items.description: House-made syrup with soda water. Ask about today's flavor.

items.description: A rotating Italian red by the glass, selected by our sommelier.
